Monetization Experiment Planner skill v1.0.0 released.

- Helps growth teams plan monetization experiments for post-PMF products with stable retention.
- Classifies business model as subscription, e-commerce, or ad-revenue and runs cohort revenue analysis to identify high-value customer segments.
- Proposes pricing experiments using pricing relativity, cohort upsell, and penny-gap handling.
- Generates a prioritized monetization experiment backlog and a cohort revenue analysis report to guide revenue optimization efforts.
- Designed to activate for common monetization and pricing questions from product and growth teams.
